title: Friends of Fire and Water
description: You and Paimon discover a suspicious campsite somewhere within Flower-Feather Clan territory. There, you unexpectedly rescue a Blubberbeast. It seems to make a good friend for your Saurian companion...

mainQuestExcel.title: Friends of Fire and Water
mainQuestExcel.description: You and Paimon discover a suspicious campsite somewhere within Flower-Feather Clan territory. There, you unexpectedly rescue a Blubberbeast. It seems to make a good friend for your Saurian companion...

dialogs.text: Sure enough, there are still some Saurians locked up here...
Who'd have thought they'd persist in their wicked ways and keep hurting Saurians, even after we destroyed their base...
Had we known, we could've chased them down and wiped them all out.
Well, they're all done for now.
True. Now let's save 'em, quick!
Rawr!
Yes, I should've been cold and cruel back then!
#Paimon can hardly imagine you being like that, {NICKNAME}... Anyway, let's help 'em first!
Hmm? Why are there Saurians in the cages here?
Something's not right here... Wait. Could they all have been captured by those people?
Have we busted some kinda Saurian trafficking ring without even realizing it?
Wonderful! Villains vanquished, by the by!
That's right! Now let's get all these Saurians outta here!
Rawr!
Doesn't matter. We took those villains out either way.
C'mon, it matters a lot — that the kidnapped Saurians can now regain their freedom, that is. Let's help them, pronto!
Wait, there's a... Blubberbeast in here? How in the world—? Guess bad guys really will sell anything...
Awrr... Bluboo!
Rroo... Mrrooh!
#Huh? You're kinda interested in the Blubberbeast, aren't you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

#{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} listens intently to the cries of the Blubberbeast and, seemingly understanding something, lifts the creature by the tail to take it over to the shallows, where they play together.
Rawr!
The Blubberbeast seems chuffed.
Sure does! Maybe they can become friends?
But that Blubberbeast doesn't seem to have the slightest bit of strength, and its two... Err, paws...? Either way, they don't seem able to flap around much.
There wasn't even a plate of food around... Perhaps they've been locked up so long that they're starving.
#If that's so, let's make something for the Blubberbeast and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to eat!
#{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} seems pretty happy, too.

flow.stepDescription: Prepare food for your animal friends

dialogs.text: We said we were going to cook, but what exactly should we make?
Hmm... We used to feed fish to the Blubberbeast Berrypuff, didn't we? In that case, a fish dish should do just fine!
#If we want the Blubberbeast and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to eat well... Natlan's special Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce might be a pretty good choice.
That's practically a specialty of mine.
Alright, let's get started then. Paimon will give you some pointers while you're at it!
Make deeper cuts.
That's right! The deeper the cuts, the deeper the flavor seeps in!
A little extra salt, a little extra happiness!
#Mmm, that sure tastes rich. {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} and the Blubberbeast are going to love it!
Mint sauce. The more, the merrier.
Hehe, that refreshing, cool taste is going to be awesome!
Chili peppers are indispensable.
Just the right amount of spiciness — enough to whet the appetite!
Flame-grilled over scorching heat — crispy on the outside, tender on the inside!
Heehee, that sounds so delicious, Paimon's drooling already.
#After a splendid culinary process, the special fish you grilled for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} and the Blubberbeast is ready...
Slow roasted — tender and juicy!
#Wow, amazing! {NICKNAME}'s secret art grilled fish... Maybe someday it'll become one of your specialties and you'll be able to cook it for our other friends!
Animals from Fontaine might be allergic to spicy food...
But it'd feel like something is missing if there's no chili at all, so why not add just a little?
Will an aquatic animal like the Blubberbeast be afraid of mint?
That's not how that works. A Blubberbeast is going to find the surface dry and hot, so adding a little mint sauce ought to help it cool down, right?
The flavor's great as-is. No need for any salt.
Yup. We've still got other seasonings, so we don't have to go so heavy on the salt.
Make shallower cuts.
Not bad. It should keep the flavor light while maintaining the original fishiness — which the Blubberbeast is sure to love.
Can't say I've perfected it, but no problem.
We said we were going to cook, but what exactly should we make?
Blubberbeasts live in the water, so it must eat fish, right? Let's do a fish dish, then.
#If we want the Blubberbeast and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to eat well... Natlan's special Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce might be a pretty good choice.

Aouhhh...
Arawr?
Awwrr...
Rawr!
Aouh?
Aouh...
Auh!
Paimon can't understand their conversation at all, but it seems they've reached an understanding...?
It's fine if you don't get it.
Makes sense. Even though the Blubberbeast doesn't have much strength, it feels like they're really happy — and Paimon feels happy for 'em, too!
As long as the emotion's there, that's all that matters.

flow.stepDescription: Deliver food to your animal friends
Deliver food to your animal friends

dialogs.text: Here comes something yummy! Don't just play around — you have to replenish your energy, too.
Rawr!
A... Aooouhh!
Hehe, looks like they're having a great time. Will you choke if you eat upside down like that, though...?
Stay safe. Don't be like that Blubberbeast.
Try it yourself and you'll see.
Hey, what's with that patronizing tone? Paimon's no Blubberbeast. She's not gonna be so silly as to eat like that.
Hey! Paimon's not gonna eat like that — she isn't a Blubberbeast anyway!
The Blubberbeast seems to have recovered enough strength for it to flap over and tumble into the sea...
Mmm... Aourgh!
Aohh! Woo... Arr!
Ah, it's gone...
That's just how things are. I mean, it's not indigenous to Natlan.
Best if it goes back where it belongs.
Rrooh...
#Don't be sad, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. You had so much fun just now, and you're already friends!
Anyway, Paimon's got a feeling that this isn't the last we've seen of that Blubberbeast!
Rawr!
